sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Growth Analyst for Noida at start 25 after the HTTP 429, then continue high-yield role and city combinations beyond start 50
sourceLanes.notes: The morning public LinkedIn Jobs sweep traversed 17 role families, four target locations, and starts 0, 25, and 50: 204 query-location-page combinations. Two hundred and three succeeded; Growth Analyst for Noida at start 25 returned HTTP 429 and is preserved as the checkpoint. Candidates were deduplicated against active and excluded IDs before detail inspection. Six fresh roles passed direct-page verification: United Airlines Tech Ops Business Intelligence, Goldman Sachs Data Quality and Governance, Rama Vision ecommerce reconciliation, Glean AI Data Analyst, Citi Python Data Analyst, and ProBuddy Business Analyst. The Glean, Citi, and ProBuddy experience-gap roles are explicitly Tier 3. The final audit also closed Target Data Analyst and Green Positive ESG internship after both listings changed to no longer accepting applications.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn employee, recruiter, and founder posts were searched independently across four query families covering fresher analytics, MIS and RevOps, junior data engineering and Data Ops, and risk, research, supply, and insights. Discoverable results were one month to two years old, expired dated walk-ins, or comment, DM, and Telegram-gated posts without a current employer destination. No fresh original post passed both the current-post and usable-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then inspect current Citi entry-level analytics listings adjacent to the newly canonicalized requisition
sourceLanes.notes: The canonicalization pass searched employer and ATS destinations for United Airlines, Goldman Sachs, Citi, Glean, Stanza Living, PlanetSpark, and ParallelDots. Citi's Python Data Analyst was promoted to its live canonical employer page, posted 24 Aug under requisition 26989180. Search indexing did not expose current exact employer pages for the other published requisitions, while their direct LinkedIn or Cutshort pages remained live with Apply. A Goldman result with a similar title was a separate vice-president role and was not substituted. ParallelDots was withheld after its direct Wellfound endpoint returned HTTP 410. No existing employer-hosted card failed the full link audit.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Authenticated Instahyre traversal, deeper Cutshort pagination, and current YC company boards, then recheck previously unavailable Wellfound IDs for state reversals
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first across Wellfound, Cutshort, Instahyre, and YC. Stanza Living Data Analyst and PlanetSpark Data Analytics passed direct verification and were added. Indexed Wellfound renderings showed current-looking Apply content for FLIP, ParallelDots, and Quant Global, but each direct endpoint returned HTTP 410 during the required audit, so none was published and all three were added to exclusions for later state-reversal checks. Instahyre remained inaccessible or generic, and the lane stays partial.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, and specialist Cutshort variants were searched independently. Internshala remained blocked, Hirist results were old or senior, and no Unstop listing passed the current-detail and route gates. The two verified Cutshort roles were recorded in the startup lane to preserve one source-family owner. No additional specialist listing was promoted.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Indeed, Foundit, and Naukri were searched for current fresher and early-career analyst roles. Naukri remained blocked; Foundit largely exposed old, closed, or duplicate index copies, including Jarvis and Nexdigm roles already represented on the board. A current-looking Sattva research-intern discovery lacked a verified canonical destination, while other discoveries resolved to archived IDs. No broad-portal listing independently passed the direct-route gate.
